sentence: This project builds a framework that uses satellite data and deep learning to detect wildfires, predict how they spread, and plan how to control them.
This project studies how energy is converted between electromagnetic fields and the thermal energy of plasmas where collisions between particles are very rare.
This project studies whether adaptive neural networks leak private user information through timing observations and builds ways to reduce that leakage.
This project improves a tool that predicts the metabolic functions of bacterial and archaeal taxa in microbiome surveys.
This project preserves and digitizes a large collection of invertebrate specimens so researchers can study biodiversity, land use, and species distribution.
This project gets a computer cluster that researchers use to screen chemical compounds against disease and to study tumors in medical images.
This project studies how microorganisms and a self-propelled robot move through thick, gel-like materials, using experiments and simulations.
This project studies the evolutionary relationships and traits of Anopheline mosquitoes to find out what drives their spread into uncolonized regions.
This project develops a single framework for teaching computers to make a series of decisions, including from data that was already collected.
This project tries to find out why certain paths are preferred when many small pieces assemble into structures, using simulations and machine learning.
This project supports a conference where researchers share work on control theory, learning-based control, and autonomous systems.
This project explores how structured laser light can control trapped ions so that quantum computing operations become faster and make fewer errors.
This project builds software that helps programmers make sense of noisy and erroneous results from quantum computers.
This project builds methods that use deep learning and causal inference to suggest treatments for patients from observational health data.
This project creates a certificate and short courses on cell and gene therapy and on mammalian cell culture techniques.
This project studies how red flour beetles decide which transcripts to turn into proteins during the early immune response to parasites.
This project studies how the shape and surface chemistry of nanoparticles affect how lymphatic vessels carry them and how fluid flow changes this.
This project measures gases and particles released by brakes and tires and how much they add to the air pollutant burden.
